title: Bilinear Rank-2 Factorization of Dirichlet Energy Kernels, Reverse-Triangle and Sieve-Horizon Obstructions, Preissmann-Montgomery-Vaughan L^2 Bounds, and Failure of Pointwise Gallagher Transfer
description: Establishes the exact rank-2 factorization w_{mn}^{int}(d,t) = 2(cosh(d*omega_m)cosh(d*omega_n)-1)/d^2 reducing O(N^2) off-diagonal Dirichlet energy sums to O(N) prefix sums and the Euclidean representation (1/4)|S_N(d,t)|^2 = ||psi_1 + Psi_{>=2}||^2, distinguishes the squarefree-divisor sieve tilde_Lambda_r(n) from Bombieri-Selberg's Lambda_r^{BS}(n) and proves the O(1) breakdown of b_n^{(r)}(X) = tilde_Lambda_r(n)/(ln X)^r for n > X, proves that ||psi_1||_min = sinh(dL/2) causes phase-blind reverse-triangle lower bounds to collapse on 0 < d < 1/2, and uses Preissmann's sharp Hilbert constant c_MV = pi*sqrt(1 + (2/3)*sqrt(6/5)) to separate Bohr-Landau/Carlson L^2 window suppression from the O(N^{1-2d}) divergence of Gallagher's Sobolev cross-term.
